title: Statement Worksheet Note — Covered Parking Rent on the Coming Month's Independent Living Statement
content:
**Rule.** Rented covered parking spaces are billed on the coming month's statement of an Independent Living Residency Agreement at the monthly covered parking rent per space, the number of spaces being the quantity on the latest covered parking charge (latest by service date): a household renting two or more spaces adds the monthly covered parking rent once for each space; a household renting one space adds it once; a household with no covered parking charge adds nothing for parking.

**Rent per space.** 55.00 per calendar month for every apartment type — Studio, One-Bedroom, One-Bedroom Deluxe, Two-Bedroom, Two-Bedroom Deluxe and Cottage Home.

## Worksheet

| Quantity on the latest covered parking charge | Parking added to the coming month's statement |
|---|---|
| 0, or no covered parking charge | 0.00 |
| 1 | 55.00 |
| 2 | 110.00 |
| 3 | 165.00 |

Worked line (hypothetical): a cottage household whose latest covered parking charge carries a quantity of 2 adds 55.00 for each space, 110.00, to the coming month's statement.
